evidence.title: Figma just made your design system debt everyone’s problem. Now use it.

name: Figma just made your design system debt everyone’s problem. Now use it.
summary: UX Collective article on how Figma's Config 2026 design-system features surface design debt — and what teams should do about it.
description: Opinion piece by Dolphia on UX Collective (June 2026, 6 min read): everything Figma shipped at Config 2026 reads from your design system, and design checks with one-click fixes make design-system debt visible to everyone; the article argues what design and product teams should do next.
contains: article by Dolphia on UX Collective
discusses Check designs, seeded violations and one-click fixes
